title: Short Sellers Gain $6B on AI Data Center Bets in October

tickers.name: Nebius Group N.V. Class A Ordinary Shares
CoreWeave, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Bearish traders targeted the builders of machine learning hardware and processing hubs throughout the current month to capitalize on falling valuations. Short sellers earned $6 billion in paper profits during October, according to Ortex data, with Nebius accounting for $2.94 billion and CoreWeave nearly $1.7 billion. Bets against IREN and Applied Digital contributed over $1.2 billion as firms grew concerned about the debt used to fund the rapid expansion of AI capacity.

Approximately $17 billion in shares across five AI infrastructure companies remain sold short. At CoreWeave, short interest climbed 15% since the start of October to 70.6 million shares, coinciding with a 28% decline in its stock price to $62.

Around $17B in shares across five AI infrastructure companies remain sold short.
